reviewer: Codex /root; same-context mathematical self-review, not independent human or theorem review
conditional_scope: Formula/specification review only; no empirical assumption, originality, GPU interface or efficacy verified.

formal_object.rationale: Each anchor vertex i has finite target modes y_i,k and model scores p_i,k>0; connected anchor graph E; no GT target coordinates. The stated object/domain, rather than the official unsquared Chamfer, is the object of this conditional derivation.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: B05: Mixture over candidate correspondences -> Separate within-mode and between-mode variation; condition: Candidate support and probabilities come from the same permitted model; H06: Posterior-mean coordinate as a universal safe correspondence -> Averaging can create an unsupported interior point; condition: Two separated valid modes are possible; D01: Finite coherent-label objective -> Construct a discrete assignment, not a temperature change; condition: Modes and pairwise geometry terms are declared All current edges remain conditional where model/data availability is not established.

derivation.rationale: The weighted variance identity holds for normalized weights without interpreting attention as a calibrated posterior. Two separated rotation modes provide a valid contraction counterexample. The proposed object is a joint spatial discrete labeling, whose general optimizer is approximate. The counterexample shows possibility, not real failure prevalence.

assumptions.rationale: Conditional validity requires: Separated modes must be exposed by an actual inspected model interface; attention confidence alone is not calibrated probability.; Spatial coherence may choose the wrong symmetric part; no unique identity is guaranteed.; Rotation hints R_ij must use legal model/anchor information and identical availability for comparators.; No full dense 32768-token attention tensor is presumed feasible on this GPU. These are obligations, not observations about ActionBench.

method_expression.rationale: Extract a bounded candidate set per landmark, perform spatially coherent discrete label search, and lift selected targets with a qualified common deformation backend. The reviewed construction is Discrete spatial mode assignment before deformation, as opposed to continuous averaging or mass balancing.. This is a specification, not an implemented method.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The construction predicts: Benefit should concentrate on separated correspondence modes; a mean blend can improve an average score while compressing the predicted shape. It can be rejected by: Reject if naturally sourced modes are unimodal, or independent top-1/temperature-matched means match the same native performance at equal search cost. This contrast is specified before any new-method experiment.

closest_alternative.rationale: Named alternatives: STAC's localized sharp blend; independent top-1; classical discrete labeling. Historical m03 also selects candidates over time, so spatial joint mode preservation needs explicit collision review. Claimed operational difference: Changes posterior reduction and joint spatial decision, not just top-k or temperature; functional originality is unresolved. This check verifies an explicit comparator and conditional delta, not completed novelty clearance.
